name: Leading Edge Data Centres Mildura regional Tier III data centre
notes: Company announcement said land was being secured in Mildura and planning applications had begun for regional Victorian Tier III data centres; later current status not independently confirmed in this pass.

name: C Capital/Lendlease Beveridge Northern Freight Precinct data centre assets
notes: Lendlease says it was appointed by C Capital to progress master planning and rezoning/infrastructure enablement for a 507 ha Beveridge site with end value up to A$4.5b spanning logistics, industrial and data centre assets.

name: Telstra InfraCo Clayton Data Centre
developer: Telstra InfraCo; Centuria Industrial REIT owner
notes: Telstra lists Clayton, Melbourne as one of its Australian data centre colocation sites; DCD reported the 1822 Dandenong Road site contains two data centres totaling around 12MW.

name: Centuria Clayton second data centre expansion
notes: DCD reported Centuria planned a second data centre of up to 40MW at 1822 Dandenong Road, with approvals and power allocation progressing and development targeted after Telstra infrastructure decommissioning anticipated by mid-2027.

name: Somerville Technology, Industry & Business Park potential data centre use
notes: State-approved rezoning enables a 37 ha technology, industry and business park at 79 and 83 Bungower Rd, Somerville. Local press reported community fears the rezoned site could host a hyperscale data centre; no confirmed data-centre operator or capacity found.
